Mimosa Pudica - 1x Mini Plug - Sensitive Plant - Interesting Moving Plant 
This is the 'Sensitive Plant' that physically reacts to your touch. A fascinating and interactive plant for any collection. 
The leaves fold inward and droop when touched, shaken, or even blown on. They then reopen again after a few minutes. It's a fantastic and fun plant for adults and children alike. 
What You Will Receive: 
1 x healthy Mimosa pudica plug plant(s). Approximately 4cm plugs.
